extraction_notes: Main-text performance figures inspected: Figure 1, Figure 10 and Figure 11. Figure 1 contains the directly plotted catalytic performance data and was digitised. Figure 10 is an operando mass-spectrometry trace reported as ion current (m/z signals), not calibrated CO2 conversion, selectivity, methanol STY or formation rate, so it was not digitised as catalytic performance. Figure 11 re-plots/normalises the same 250 °C productivity/conversion dataset against XRD-derived alloy metrics; the direct reactor-performance values are already captured from Figure 1, while crystallite/alloy-content variables were not entered as separate catalyst-performance records.
